title: Singleton projection retracts the local augmentation in degree zero
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $r\in\mathbb N$, $U:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to X.\mathrm{Opens}$, $G$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, and $i:\operatorname{Fin}(r)$. Use the explicit complex and augmentation [def-pc-s3-alternating-cech-sheaf-construction]. Write $S$ for $G[0]$ extended by zero to integer degrees, $C$ for the integer extension of the alternating complex, and $F$ for restriction to $U_i$. Write $a:F(S)\to F(C)$ for the restricted extended augmentation. There is a module morphism $\pi:F(C^0)\to F(S^0)$ with $a^0\pi=1_{F(S^0)}$.

source.place: Tag 02FU, local insertion and degree-zero projection; ordered adaptation using Tag 01FM; parent insertion-homotopy proof

proof.text: Prove continuity of the intersection functor V ↦ V ∩ U i: factor it, up to the natural isomorphism of opens given by set extensionality, as the inverse-image functor for U i → X followed by the open-image functor. Both functors are continuous for the opens sites, and Mathlib Functor.isContinuous_of_iso transfers continuity to the intersection functor. This property applies to sheaves with arbitrary coefficient categories; specialize Functor.op_comp_isSheaf to the underlying abelian-group sheaf of G to form the module sheaf H. Project the degree-zero presheaf product to the singleton i. The augmentation followed by this projection is the restriction unit b : G → H. After restriction to U i, b is an isomorphism, since each test open is contained in U i. Apply sheafification to the projection and compose with its counit at H. Adjunction naturality and the right triangle identity identify the augmentation composite with b. Compose with the inverse of restricted b to obtain a left inverse in natural degree zero. Transport this left inverse through extendXIso to integer degree zero. No index exists when r = 0; the argument also applies to empty U i.

lean.statement:
theorem alternatingCechSheafAugmentation_restrict_degreeZero_retraction
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {r : ℕ} (U : Fin r → X.Opens) (G : X.Modules) (i : Fin r) :
    let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι
    let A := ((CochainComplex.single₀ X.Modules).obj G).extend
      ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat
    let C := (alternatingCechSheafComplex U G).extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat
    let a := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (alternatingCechSheafAugmentation U G)
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
    ∃ π : F.obj (C.X 0) ⟶ F.obj (A.X 0), a.f 0 ≫ π = 𝟙 _
